diffs.diff: pin count: part has 5 (PWM GND + LOAD -), datasheet reading has 2 (PWM GND)
diffs.evidence: ProtoSupplies D4184 MOSFET Control Module product page: '1 x 2 Screw Terminal / Header (Logic Signal Input) PWM = Signal input (active HIGH). GND = Signal ground' and '1 x 3 Screw Terminal (Load Power Supply Connections) + = Connect to power supply (6-36V) being used to power the load - = Connect to power supply ground ... + = Connect to positive lead of load ... LOAD = Connect to negative lead of load'; also 'DC Load Power Supply: is connected to the 3-pin screw terminals marked + / LOAD / - on the back of the module.' The board has 5 connection points (PWM, GND, +, LOAD, -); the second reading listed only the 2-pin logic header and omitted the 3-pin load terminal.
